| | Atomic number | 1 |

| | Electron configuration | 1s¹ |
| | Isotopes | ¹H (protium), ²H (deuterium), ³H (tritium) |
| | State at STP | Gas (colorless, odorless, tasteless) |

| | Density (gas, 0 °C, 1 atm) | 0.0899 g L⁻¹ |

| | Standard entropy | 130.68 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ |

| **Chemical Behavior** | Most common oxidation state | +1 (as H⁺) |
| | Most common reduction state | –1 (as H⁻) |
| | Acidic behavior | Acts as a proton donor (H⁺) |
| | Basic behavior | Acts as a hydride donor (H⁻) |
| | Bonding with oxygen | Forms H₂O, H₂O₂, HOCl, etc. |
| | Bonding with nitrogen | Forms NH₃, HCN, etc. |
| | Bonding with carbon | Forms hydrocarbons (CH₄, C₂H₆, etc.) |
| | Bonding with metals | Forms metal hydrides (LiH, NaH, MgH₂, etc.) |
| | Bonding with halogens | Forms hydrogen halides (HF, HCl, HBr, HI) |
| | Bonding with noble gases | Forms weak van der Waals complexes (e.g., H₂–Ar) |
| | Reaction with oxygen | Combustion → H₂O (exothermic) |
| | Reaction with nitrogen | Ammonia synthesis (Haber process) |
| | Reaction with carbon dioxide | Formation of formic acid (HCOOH) |
| | Reaction with sulfur | Forms hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) |
| | Reaction with acids | Forms salts (e.g., NaCl + H₂ → NaCl + H₂) |

| | Reaction with metals | Forms metal hydrides (e.g., Mg + 2H₂O → Mg(OH)₂ + H₂) |
| | Reaction with alkali metals | Forms metal hydrides (e.g., Li + H₂ → LiH + H₂) |
| | Reaction with transition metals | Forms metal hydride complexes (e.g., Pt–H) |
| | Reaction with organic compounds | Hydrogenation (adds H₂ across double bonds) |
| | Reaction with radicals | Forms stable molecules (e.g., H + O₂ → HO₂) |
| | Reaction with plasma | Ionized hydrogen (H⁺, H₂⁺, H₃⁺) |
| | Reaction with UV light | Photodissociation → H + H |
| | Reaction with high pressure | Forms high‑pressure phases (e.g., metallic hydrogen) |
| | Reaction with high temperature | Decomposition of water → H₂ + O₂ |
| | Reaction with catalysts | Hydrogenation, dehydrogenation, reforming, etc. |
